name: Partícula — Chispa (Phaser ParticleEmitter)
generation_strategy: 1 frame único. Phaser ParticleEmitter anima y controla el movimiento.

frames.role: Punto de chispa — textura base del emitter de chispas
frames.prompt: A single bright white glowing dot/spark, perfectly centered on transparent background. Just a tiny luminous point of light, white center fading to transparent at the edges — a perfect radial gradient circle. Very small, clean. Will be tinted in the game engine. NOT pixel art, NO color, NO outline, NO background, NO text.
frames.negative_prompt: pixel art, elongated, streak, large, colored, outlined, background, text, watermark

usages: Chispas de impacto (complemento del VFX spritesheet): tintado naranja (#FF8800)
Power Stack aura: partículas orbitando al tanque, tintado según tier (verde/naranja/rojo)
